intent: Generate the telemetry-ingestion-processing project root and build scaffold using the mcp-server-springboot skill, with language version Java 21, framework version Spring Boot 3, and build dependencies webflux, data-r2dbc, flyway, actuator, validation, h2, postgresql, test, reactor-test (spring-boot-starter-test and reactor-test on the test classpath). Send bootVersion and javaVersion from these pins, never generator defaults; java.version in the build manifest must be 21. Require: a SINGLE composition root (one boot class in base package com.blackboard.telemetry, no second boot class); test-run timeout guardrails in the build manifest (surefire fork timeout) so a hung test fails fast; a schema MIGRATION RUNNER (flyway-core plus flyway-database-postgresql) wired into the build, plus an embeddable in-process H2 substitute (r2dbc-h2 and h2, test-scoped) so the scaffold boot test passes without external services.
